output.summary: A milky-sapped perennial native to western North America. It bears dense clusters of pale pink to pinkish-purple, star-shaped flowers and rough pods filled with silky-haired seeds. Young leaves and seed pods can be boiled and eaten, but care is needed to distinguish it from highly toxic related species.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves and seed pods can be boiled and eaten; careful identification is needed because related milkweeds may be highly toxic.
